About Me

The Story Behind the Brand

I'm Gaurab Barakoti, a professional bartender with a passion for technology and digital storytelling. My journey is unique—I blend hospitality expertise with technical innovation to create meaningful digital products and engaging content that resonates across platforms.

By day, I craft memorable experiences behind the bar, perfecting mixology and customer service. By night, I'm building TRIDEV CORE HQ, a multi-platform content empire dedicated to Nepal, technology, Sanatan Dharma, history, and conscious hip-hop.

What Drives Me

  • Innovation: Leveraging AI tools and web technologies to solve real problems
  • Authenticity: Creating content that represents Nepal's diverse voice globally
  • Excellence: Whether it's a cocktail or code, quality is non-negotiable
  • Growth: Continuous learning across technology, business, and creative fields

I believe the future belongs to those who can bridge disciplines—combining technical skills with creative vision and interpersonal excellence. That's exactly what I'm building.
